label: SI-6
title: Security and Privacy Function Verification

children.label: a.
children.prose: Verify the correct operation of {{ insert: param, si-6_prm_1 }};

children.label: b.
children.prose: Perform the verification of the functions specified in SI-6a {{ insert: param, si-06_odp.03 }};

children.label: c.
children.prose: Alert {{ insert: param, si-06_odp.06 }} to failed security and privacy verification tests; and

children.label: d.
children.prose: {{ insert: param, si-06_odp.07 }} when anomalies are discovered.

guidance: Transitional states for systems include system startup, restart, shutdown, and abort. System notifications include hardware indicator lights, electronic alerts to system administrators, and messages to local computer consoles. In contrast to security function verification, privacy function verification ensures that privacy functions operate as expected and are approved by the senior agency official for privacy or that privacy attributes are applied or used as expected.

params.label: security functions
guidelines: security functions to be verified for correct operation are defined;

params.label: privacy functions
guidelines: privacy functions to be verified for correct operation are defined;

choice: upon command by user with appropriate privilege
